productBulk.title: Product imports
productBulk.intro: Prepare up to 50,000 product changes from files or a scoped request. Review exact changes before they run in the background. Deletions need separate approval.
productBulk.name: Name
productBulk.fileHelp: Up to 10 files, 10 MiB each: XLSX, CSV or PDF. IDs and codes stay literal. A missing product in a file never means delete.
productBulk.fileInvalid: Choose no more than 10 supported, nonempty files of up to 10 MiB each.
productBulk.openCreatedDraft: Open saved draft and check uploaded sources
productBulk.error: Could not complete this request. Check your connection and permissions, then retry.
productBulk.backgroundHelp: Work continues when you navigate away or close the conversation. This page restores saved progress after reload.
productBulk.pasteHelp: Paste catalog or table text. Ambiguous or missing values stay unresolved for review.
productBulk.mappingHelp: Map each table explicitly. Check sheet, header row and exact identity columns; leave unrelated columns ignored. Mapping changes invalidate earlier reviews.
productBulk.target: Exact product ID or matching key
productBulk.editInvalidates: Saving a correction creates a new revision and invalidates previous approvals. Blank update values keep existing data; clearing is explicit.
productBulk.approvalHelp: Approval covers the frozen revision only. Check every included change using the searchable row pages. Creates and updates share one approval; deletions have a separate review. Unresolved rows do not run.
productBulk.deleteConfirm: Delete {count} explicitly selected products from revision {revision}. Native deletion guards still apply. Committed deletions are retained if the run is cancelled.
productBulk.writeConfirm: Queue {count} reviewed creates and updates from revision {revision}. Changed products become conflicts. This approval authorizes only the frozen payload.
productBulk.cancelHelp: Cancellation stops future chunks. Changes already committed remain visible in the report.
productBulk.remainder: Create new draft for unresolved rows
productBulk.templateHelp: Keep the typed column keys unchanged. Delete example rows before importing. Decimal values use a dot; dates use YYYY-MM-DD; codes and IDs are text. Custom choices use stable option IDs. Blank updates keep existing values.

reserved._operation: Row operation: create, update or delete

budget.title: Extraction budget (admin)
budget.help: Set the maximum AI spend for each run before extraction. Reservations include retries; hitting the cap pauses extraction for review.

fields.title: Product custom fields
fields.help: Reusable, typed workspace fields. Definitions and options use stable IDs. Archived fields keep existing values; only active definitions accept assignments.
fields.label: Label
fields.requiredHelp: A required field can become active only after all live products have values. No automatic backfill. The server reports missing values when activation is refused. Activate as optional, populate values, then mark required.
fields.archiveHelp: Existing values remain readable. New assignments to this field are refused.
fields.productValues: Browse products and edit custom values

transforms.title: Value transforms (advanced)
transforms.label: JSON transforms by source column
transforms.help: Use explicit decimal, date, boolean, mapping, split, scale or tax conversions. Unknown values remain row errors. Never include executable code or URLs.
transforms.invalid: Enter a JSON object with one transform object per mapped source column, including its kind.

scope.title: Prepare a scoped product request
scope.help: Choose product IDs or an explicit search/status filter. The server freezes matching products and calculates changes. This step does not approve product writes.

raw.title: Original source cells
raw.help: Literal source values. Formula results are cached values; formulas are never executed.
raw.truncated: Preview is shortened to eight cells and 256 characters per cell. Open exact values to inspect all original content.
raw.formula: Cached formula value; formula was not executed.

guidance.title: Next step
guidance.working: Your catalog is being prepared or applied in the background. No answer is needed while work continues.
guidance.clarify: Some details need a decision. Review flagged rows and exact source values; confirmed work stays saved. AI can inspect these rows and prepare corrections without changing products.
guidance.approval: Your validated changes are ready for exact review. Approve creates and updates once; explicit deletions need their own approval.
guidance.paused: Preparation is paused. Check the displayed provider or budget issue, then resume from saved progress.
guidance.recovery: Some changes remain unresolved. Check receipts and prepare a fresh draft for the remaining rows; completed changes stay committed.
guidance.receipt: Review the recorded outcome and downloadable receipt. The run status shows whether work completed, stopped or expired.
guidance.source: Add product files or a scoped request. Clear mappings and validation run automatically; only unresolved details and final approval need your decision.

productBulk.duplicateHeaders: Repeated column headers cannot select one source value safely. Give those columns distinct headers before assigning their values. Original source cells remain available for inspection.
